description: Golden test set for the THS scanner. Every expected value was verified by hand on 2026-09-24 from on-chain reads or primary sources, collected with standalone scripts that do not use the scanner code, and never copied from a THS page or report. The scanner must not deploy if any case fails (run: deno test -A golden/). A failure after deploy means drift or a provider problem: re-verify by hand before changing an expected value.

matchers.approx + abs: value within absolute tolerance (percentage points for pct fields)
matchers.status: field status must be this (ok | unknown | disputed)
matchers.reason: field reason code must be this
matchers.not_eq_path: value must NOT equal the value at this other path (e.g. circulating must not be defaulted to total)
matchers.flag_absent: no plausibility flag with this rule at severity warning or error
matchers.flag_present: a plausibility flag with this rule (any severity) must exist
